positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationRetraction
positions.frame: Does the observatory's record hold any calibration of the Kestrelwood spectrograph at all, or is that calibration to be struck from it?
positions.why: All three segments read in one direction: the speaker orders the Kestrelwood calibration and everything attached to it (the spectrograph, the 88.4 MHz value, Quill Ashgrove's calibration work) removed, and states that the observatory never calibrated the instrument. The two directives and the factual assertion cohere around whether a calibration belongs in the record. The assertion carries no evidence of its own, and it denies what the existing calibration position holds, so the two positions stay in tension.
